title: Multi-Strategy
description: Our flagship strategy dynamically allocates across equities, fixed income and commodities, aiming to deliver consistent, risk-adjusted returns through market cycles.
subtitle: Our flagship, dynamically allocated strategy
fullDescription: Multi-Strategy is Giantfuse's flagship approach, allocating dynamically across our Long/Short Equities, Fixed Income and Commodities strategies. By diversifying across uncorrelated return streams, we aim to deliver consistent performance with lower volatility than any single strategy alone.

title: Long/Short Equities
description: We take long and short equity positions across market cycles, combining high-conviction stock selection with disciplined risk management.
subtitle: High-conviction, risk-managed equity exposure
fullDescription: Our Long/Short Equities strategy combines high-conviction, bottom-up stock selection with active risk management, taking both long and short positions to capture opportunity while managing downside exposure across market cycles.

title: Fixed Income
description: An alternative credit strategy seeking attractive total returns through semi-liquid and event-driven credit, while actively managing duration.
subtitle: Attractive income with managed duration
fullDescription: Our Fixed Income strategy seeks attractive total returns — including current income and capital appreciation — by investing in semi-liquid and event-driven credit, while managing duration to limit exposure to interest-rate movements.
highlights: Lower volatility than core fixed income

title: Commodities
description: We seek attractive returns across commodity markets by leveraging our team's global presence and a bottom-up, value-driven approach.
subtitle: Global, value-driven commodity exposure
fullDescription: Our Commodities strategy pursues attractive returns across energy, agricultural commodities and metals, leveraging our team's global presence and a disciplined, bottom-up, value-driven approach to volatile, supply-constrained markets.
